physio.name: Physio
physio.job: Checks the live site every morning: every seed page answers, nothing served stale, no broken chunk, certificate and sitemaps in order, and whether main is ahead of production.

umpire.name: Umpire
umpire.job: Reads the ops report every morning and turns each failing section, stale heartbeat, duplicate row and integrity gap into a scored finding, cross-checking three of yesterday's completed games against ESPN's own scoreboard.
umpire.never: Connects to the database directly, or suggests deleting rows without naming the exact ids.

kit-manager.name: Kit Manager
kit-manager.job: Runs PageSpeed Insights against the home page, a league page, a match page, an article page and a player page on mobile and desktop, and flags layout shift, accessibility drops, contrast and tap-target failures, and performance regressions.
kit-manager.never: Runs Lighthouse against the VM origin directly, only the public URL.

analyst.name: Analyst
analyst.job: Validates every sitemap, the IndexNow key file and the JSON-LD on a game, article and player page, and watches Search Console and Bing numbers for a week-on-week drop.
analyst.never: Submits anything to a search engine.

scout.name: Scout
scout.job: Checks whether the newest article and recent games are indexed, finds pages missing from the sitemap or under-linked internally, and writes one concrete reach suggestion a day.

editor.name: Editor
editor.job: Finds the open article pull request, verifies every number in the draft with a web search, checks house style, and runs the test suite and type check on the branch before writing a merge verdict.
editor.never: Comments on, approves, merges or edits the pull request.

press-officer.name: Press Officer
press-officer.job: Reads the X daily plan and yesterday's results, drafts up to three ready-to-post updates, and flags any story already posted in the last week.
press-officer.never: Posts, replies, schedules or writes to any social account or document.

scorer.name: Scorer
scorer.job: Reads yesterday's view counts from the ops report and writes the daily numbers document with the top games, country and platform splits.

steward.name: Steward
steward.job: Runs a dependency audit, checks security headers and TLS expiry, and greps the tree for tracked secrets or key-shaped strings.

r1.text: Deploy from main only, after the pull request is merged. Never between 04:30 and 07:30 IST, when the daily scrape runs.

r2.text: Purge the Cloudflare cache once after every deploy, then check /beyond-the-scoreline serves the new build.

r3.text: Agents report. They never commit, merge, post or change a setting.

r4.text: Nothing is posted to X without the owner's approval of the exact copy.

r5.text: Numbers in articles are verified by search or left out.

r6.text: To do: set up an external uptime monitor pinging https://sports-db.live/api/health every five minutes. Owner action.
